finalWordDataChecks.name: it: native word bank has unique alphabetic targets and clues
it: all three difficulty pools produce meaningful unique choices (300 seeds)
en: native word bank has unique alphabetic targets and clues
en: all three difficulty pools produce meaningful unique choices (300 seeds)
pl: native word bank has unique alphabetic targets and clues
pl: all three difficulty pools produce meaningful unique choices (300 seeds)

methodology: Isolated local browser tests of the committed app; synthetic Phantom provider and lock evidence, no real wallet or chain transaction. Desktop 1280x800 and emulated 390x844 portrait / 844x390 landscape. Native user input through the picker; question generator also sampled in an isolated VM. Final word-data recheck covers all 3 locales and levels with 900 generated questions.
limitations: Existing English audio subtitle content and English demo recordings are unchanged.
Known dictionary ambiguities were corrected; seeded samples are not an exhaustive language dictionary.
